summary: Chromosome number, one of the listed mitotic details, is well covered: ACC (~18,000 animal species, CC BY CSV on Zenodo 4635457) and CCDB (plants, per-genus JSON with many records per species, e.g. 1,447 for Crepis). The other details (visible karyokinesis, spindle position, chromosome form and arrangement) have no cross-species coded table; imaging exists for single model species (IDR MitoCheck, many BioImage Archive sets) and one comparative study of two ichthyosporeans (S-BIAD1306, CC BY 4.0).
next_step: Pre-register the chromosome-number part now (variance partitioning within species / within genus / among orders from ACC + CCDB against a molecular tree); for spindle and chromosome-form characters, compile a coded matrix from the cytology literature.
obstacles_confirmed: Chromosome number is only one of the listed details; form, arrangement and spindle position are not in these databases.
Some listed features require specialist recoding from publications.
